list.title: Positions
list.subtitle: Add, edit, and delete positions per company. Positions are used as a selectable field when registering or editing employees.
list.deleteHint: ℹ A position can only be deleted if no employees currently use it. Change any affected employees' position first, then delete.
list.codeExtra: A short identifier code that must be unique within the company.
list.codeUnavailable: This code is already in use.
list.orderExtra: Display order in the position list (ascending).
list.duplicateWarning: Duplicate position code. Please enter a different code.
list.deleteConfirmMsg: Are you sure you want to delete the position {{posName}}?
list.deleteHint2: This position cannot be deleted while employees are assigned to it.
